mapper.select: SELECT nestConfig.id AS id, nestConfig.workshop_id AS workshop_id, nestConfig.process_id AS process_id, nestConfig.team_id AS team_id, nestConfig.code_rule AS code_rule, nestConfig.code_name AS code_name, nestConfig.display_rule AS display_rule, nestConfig.team_display_rule AS team_display_rule, nestConfig.bool_show_codename, workshop.name AS workshop_name, process.name AS process_name, userLink.user_name AS team_name FROM mes_building_nest_team_config nestConfig LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON nestConfig.workshop_id = workshop.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON nestConfig.process_id = process.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link userLink ON nestConfig.team_id = userLink.team_id AND userLink.bool_delete_enum=0 WHERE nestConfig.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND userLink.bool_leader_enum = 1 ORDER BY nestConfig.create_time DESC

SELECT userLink.user_name AS team_name, team.id AS team_id, process.NAME AS process_name, process.id AS process_id FROM mes_building_team team LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link userLink ON userLink.team_id = team.id AND userLink.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON team.process_id = process.id AND process.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE userLink.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND team.id = #{teamId}
